nodes.rationale: Authorized live TestNav practice environment inspected for layout measurements; no reference questions, code, logos, or assets were imported.

nodes.label: TEI Compatibility (no content/attempt migration)
nodes.rationale: Keep question, choice, slot and menu IDs, keys, string answers and response maps; original grading functions unchanged.

nodes.label: New Interaction Procedure
nodes.rationale: Extend an existing component where possible; do not introduce an importer-specific renderer.

nodes.label: TestNav as Presentation Authority
nodes.rationale: Imports provide content, metadata, and verified keys; their widgets, CSS, and event handlers do not define the player UI.

nodes.label: Presentation Standard (existing TestNav controls only)
nodes.rationale: Import content and configuration only; never import source widgets, CSS, or handlers, or create a new layout to imitate a provider.

nodes.label: design-md-drift Finding
nodes.rationale: A commit count is not a contradiction; never assert DESIGN.md is stale because the number is large.

nodes.label: Finding Severity (auto / mention / route)
nodes.rationale: Severity says what should happen, not how bad the finding is.

nodes.label: workspace-platform-native-evidence Finding
nodes.rationale: One inherited product record cannot hold two platforms, so a native workspace needs its own child PRODUCT.md.

nodes.label: Eight Canonical Sections
nodes.rationale: Tooling parsing depends on exact headers, so sections are never renamed.

nodes.label: .impeccable/design.json Sidecar
nodes.rationale: Carries what Stitch's schema cannot hold (tonal ramps, shadows, motion, breakpoints, component snippets, narrative); extends the frontmatter without duplicating it.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md Format Spec
nodes.rationale: Tokens are normative; prose provides context for how to apply them.

nodes.label: Product Truth Interview
nodes.rationale: Whether anyone can answer is a mechanical test, not a judgment call; probe once before inferring from the brief, and label every inferred fact.

nodes.label: PRODUCT.md (durable product truth)
nodes.rationale: Init captures product truth only; it never invents a visual world or writes DESIGN.md.

nodes.label: impeccable:product-schema Marker
nodes.rationale: Lets later versions tell a deliberately short record from one written before a section existed, so the user is never re-interviewed.

nodes.label: impeccable-documenter Agent
nodes.rationale: DESIGN.md is written at finish from the built world; a rulebook written before the build gets defended against reality instead of describing it.

nodes.label: Visual Authority Resolution
nodes.rationale: A missing DESIGN.md does not erase a coherent identity already in code; a local addition never becomes a new identity exercise.

nodes.label: Deprecated Fields Are Binding
nodes.rationale: Preserving a retired field just in case lets a retired axis keep steering current output.

nodes.label: Schema Drift
nodes.rationale: Artifacts written by an older Impeccable carry fields nothing reads or miss expected ones; this is mechanical, so doctor repairs most of it.

nodes.label: Truth Drift
nodes.rationale: No file comparison can settle whether a document still describes the code, so doctor hands document/init a specific gap instead of asserting staleness.

nodes.label: Named Rules
nodes.rationale: Named rules are memorable, citable, and stickier for AI consumers than bullet lists.

nodes.label: Extract Only What Is Used 3+ Times
nodes.norm_label: extract only what is used 3+ times
nodes.rationale: Premature abstraction is worse than duplication; design systems grow incrementally.

nodes.label: Default vs Departure Mode (Phase B)
nodes.rationale: Unsure means default: a wrong default is recoverable, a wrong departure yields three off-brand variants and is not.

nodes.label: Identity Lock (Phase A)
nodes.rationale: Live runs on an existing surface whose brand is already chosen; the worst failure is three off-brand variants the user cannot accept.

nodes.label: Persona-Based Design Testing (Alex, Jordan, Sam, Riley, Casey)
nodes.norm_label: persona-based design testing (alex, jordan, sam, riley, casey)
nodes.rationale: A single design-director perspective misses failure modes that distinct user archetypes expose.

nodes.label: Simplification Dimensions (IA, visual, layout, interaction, content, code)
nodes.norm_label: simplification dimensions (ia, visual, layout, interaction, content, code)

nodes.label: Implementation Integrity Dimension
nodes.rationale: Checks whether the implementation expresses a coherent product-specific system; deterministic findings are kept separate from visual judgment.

nodes.label: Critique Snapshot Persistence (critique-storage)
nodes.rationale: The chat report is the deliverable and the snapshot only an archive; composing the report solely into the persistence file means the run produced nothing.

nodes.label: DEGRADED Single-Context Banner
nodes.rationale: A silent degraded critique is a failed critique; the report header must declare how assessments were run.

nodes.label: Sub-Agent Gate (isolated dual assessments)
nodes.rationale: A and B must not see each other's output because detector output, though deterministic, still anchors judgment.

nodes.label: Simplicity Removes Obstacles, Not Features
nodes.rationale: Simplicity is about removing obstacles between users and goals; every element should justify its existence.
